_readme: Approved copy for every Yard Microwaves Klaviyo message. Plain text with tokens: {first name}, {order #}, {coupon}, {checkout link}, {tracking link}. Blank line in body = new paragraph. copy.mjs turns this into HTML + Klaviyo tags. Edited through the Copy tab of the YM Email Inventory sheet (node sheet.mjs pull) — see README.

welcome-1-new.name: Welcome #1 - New Subscriber (10% Off)
welcome-1-new.subject: Welcome to the Yard. Mind the extension cord.
welcome-1-new.preheader: 10% off your first tee. Nobody's hurt yet.
welcome-1-new.headline: You joined a barbecue email list. On purpose.
welcome-1-new.body:
Two childhood friends, one backyard, more extension cord than common sense. That's us.

Now you get the drop previews, the deals, and an unreasonable amount of brisket. Here's 10% off your first tee. Don't tell the neighbors.
welcome-1-new.coupon: Use code {coupon} for 10% off your first tee

welcome-1-existing.name: Welcome #1 - Existing Customer
welcome-1-existing.subject: Regular status: confirmed
welcome-1-existing.preheader: Drops on Saturdays. You're first now.
welcome-1-existing.headline: You're on the list.
welcome-1-existing.body: Now you get the drops first. Saturdays. That's the deal.

welcome-2-follow.name: Welcome #2 - Follow Us
welcome-2-follow.subject: We misbehave on Instagram
welcome-2-follow.preheader: Come watch us nearly burn things.
welcome-2-follow.headline: Follow us. Watch us learn.
welcome-2-follow.lede: This email list is the well-behaved version of us.
welcome-2-follow.body: Instagram gets the rest: drop previews, design sketches, and every time a fire extinguisher makes an appearance. Come for the tees. Stay for the poor decisions.

abandoned-cart-1.name: Abandoned Cart #1
abandoned-cart-1.subject: HEADS UP, PITMASTER!
abandoned-cart-1.preheader: You left the lid up! Your cart’s losing heat—and flavor.
abandoned-cart-1.headline: Heads up, Pitmaster!
abandoned-cart-1.lede: You left the lid up! Your cart's losing heat — and flavor.
abandoned-cart-1.body: We saved everything right where you left it. Come back and close that lid before the smoke escapes.

abandoned-cart-2.name: Abandoned Cart #2
abandoned-cart-2.subject: TRUE BARBECUE WISDOM INCOMING
abandoned-cart-2.preheader: It’s rested. It’s ready. Time to carve into that cart and claim your reward.
abandoned-cart-2.headline: It's rested. It's ready.
abandoned-cart-2.lede: True barbecue wisdom: low and slow wins — but not this slow.
abandoned-cart-2.body: Your cart has had plenty of time to rest. Time to carve into it and claim your reward.

abandoned-cart-3.name: Abandoned Cart #3 (15% Off)
abandoned-cart-3.subject: FOR THE SAUCE LOVERS OUT THERE
abandoned-cart-3.preheader: Sauce boss status: confirmed. Use your 15% before it drips away.
abandoned-cart-3.headline: A little sauce on the house
abandoned-cart-3.coupon: Use code {coupon} for 15% off your cart — good for the next 48 hours, then it drips away.

browse-abandonment-1.name: Browse Abandonment #1
browse-abandonment-1.subject: You looked. We noticed.
browse-abandonment-1.headline: We saw that.
browse-abandonment-1.lede: You looked at a tee and walked off, {first name}.
browse-abandonment-1.body: Happens to us in the sauce aisle all the time. It's still there. Fewer of them than there were, but still there.

browse-abandonment-2.name: Browse Abandonment #2
browse-abandonment-2.subject: Last look before it's gone
browse-abandonment-2.preheader: We won't bring it up again.
browse-abandonment-2.headline: Final call from the pit.
browse-abandonment-2.lede: This is the last time we'll mention it, {first name}.
browse-abandonment-2.body: The tee's still in stock today. Once the drop sells through, it doesn't come back until the next one, and that's weeks out. Your call.

review-request.name: Review Request
review-request.subject: Did it survive the cookout?
review-request.preheader: Sauce stains count as a review.
review-request.headline: Tell us how it went.
review-request.lede: By now your tee has met smoke, sauce, or both.
review-request.body: We'd like to know how it held up, {first name}. Be honest. We've heard worse from each other.

review-reminder.name: Review Reminder
review-reminder.subject: Your tee is still not reviewed
review-reminder.preheader: We checked. Twice. It's not there.
review-reminder.headline: The tee's feeling ignored.
review-reminder.body: but the tee's been home a while now and hasn't heard a word. A sentence will do. “Fits, funny, smells like hickory” is a perfectly good review.

order-confirmation.name: Order Confirmation
order-confirmation.subject: You bought a shirt from us. Thank you.
order-confirmation.preheader: Order {order #} confirmed. We're already bragging about it.
order-confirmation.headline: Somebody bought a tee!
order-confirmation.lede: Order {order #} is confirmed, {first name}, and we're genuinely thrilled.
order-confirmation.body: We're printing it now, which is quieter than it sounds. Shipping email lands in a few days. In the meantime, go put something on the smoker.

shipping-confirmation.name: Shipping Confirmation
shipping-confirmation.subject: Shipped: order {order #}
shipping-confirmation.headline: On its way.
shipping-confirmation.body: Track it below. Watch the mailbox, not the pot.

S01.name: Cart reminder SMS

S02.name: Order confirmation SMS
S02.body: Order’s locked, shirt’s coming, chicken’s smoking. You’re living right.

S03.name: Shipping confirmation SMS
S03.body: Your tee’s on the move—smoked, packed, and headed for glory {order #} have been shipped. Click here to track your package: {tracking link}

S04.name: Review invite SMS
S04.body: That tee’s broken in by now—mind dropping a quick review between grill sessions?
